journal.title: Reference inspected · Blender ready
journal.notes: Visually reviewed all four supplied views. Using original mesh, procedural markings and a strand groom. No downloaded model, texture, or animal asset is used.

journal.title: First sculpt and multiview review
journal.notes: Coat layout and raised tail recognizable. Correcting protruding eyes, arched ears, gray blacks, segmented legs, and the rectangular cap boundary visible in profile.

journal.title: Continuous anatomy and darker coat
journal.notes: Better legs, tail position and coat contrast. Smaller eyes are partly occluded by cheeks; the next pass carves anatomical eye sockets, tapers ear folds, separates toes and softens the under-chin lighting.

journal.title: Natural eye sockets and soft facial lighting
journal.notes: Eyes now fully visible and integrated. Closed body mesh, finite vertices, matching left/right paw heights. Remaining priorities: furry ear interiors, toe definition, organic tail-root/ankle markings, exact ground contact, and orthographic floor-edge artifacts.

journal.title: Grounded paws, detailed groom and clean multiview framing
journal.notes: Closed body, matching paw heights, 108344 authored fibers, and six Eevee views. Close-up review identifies stepped blaze edges, exposed dark eye rims, and ear-fold shape as remaining likeness issues. Curve-fur experiments remain separate, not silently substituted for the approved scene.

journal.title: Continuous coat pigment; facial regression identified
journal.notes: The analytic field removes stepped blaze boundaries and the web model compresses to about 2.2 MB. Close-up review finds eyelid annuli and ear interiors too bulky. This pass is rated below pass 4; the next pass reduces those forms and refines fur density and fiber length.

journal.title: Fine native groom and corneal optics
journal.notes: Finer editable native fibers, narrower eyelids and real corneal reflections improve the face. Remaining issues: ear-root attachment, overlong paw fur, and excessive internal eye reflection under physical lighting. These are targeted in pass 7.

journal.title: Cleaner optical shading; ear-root regression identified
journal.notes: Pupils no longer add their own glossy reflections, paw fur is shorter, and rendered attribution is included. The attempted lower ear roots create drooping outer edges, so this pass is rated slightly below pass 6. Replacing the ear patch with scalp-anchored folded triangles.

journal.title: Recovered pass-eight review
journal.notes: Reviewed hero, front and close-up. Remaining issues: vertically stretched projecting eyes, coarse facial fur, parallel brow whiskers and low chin ridge.

journal.title: Finer groom and rounder eyes; coating regression
journal.notes: Hero reviewed: finer native strands, a lifted chin and less uniform brow whiskers improve form. The experimental reflection film flattens the pupils, so this pass is below the recovered 86 score. Correcting shallow physical cornea, groomed eyelid margins and scalp-resting folded ear tips.

journal.title: Rounder eyes and scalp-resting folded ears
journal.notes: Reviewed front, profile, rear, hero and close-up. Shallow cornea restores better eye depth; ear tips follow the scalp. The fast review mode uses reduced shadow sampling. Next: stagger the coincident legs, add dense facial microfur and soften the triangular nose.

journal.title: Dense facial microfur and natural staggered stance
journal.notes: Reviewed hero, detail and right profile. Denser short facial fibers remove the coarse scalp appearance, the nose is now softly lobed, and far-side paws no longer exactly coincide. Remaining priorities: eyelid rim shading, gray corneal reflection, and soft presentation lighting.

journal.title: Soft studio presentation and cleaner eye shading
journal.notes: Reviewed hero, front, both profiles, rear and close-up. Softer EEVEE studio shadows, matte eyelids, denser facial fibers, rounded nose and staggered paws improve the original model. Still a stylized approximation: ear silhouette, optical realism and fur fidelity remain below the requested >95 target.
